what: The Portugal Wire as it was in its vault when this site was last released: headlines and primary links, each story's edition and dated corrections, the desk's latest release note. The live edition is the vault (p6twygul); this file is the fallback and the index for agents.

wire.title: The Portugal Wire
wire.description: What happened in Portugal in the five areas the newsroom writes about: building with AI and models, AI business, open source, cybersecurity, and risk, governance and regulation. Portuguese sources and Portuguese stories, each with its headline and summary in English and Portuguese, the quote in the language of its source, and a map of the organisations named.

kind: first edition: two weeks of Portugal, with September context

latest_release.title: Verifier's fixes to four stories
latest_release.summary: An independent check of 10 stories found every quote exact and four summaries to tighten: the SIRP breach (CNCS regime, applicants figure), the data-centre investment figure (sector-wide, not per GW), Web Summit (2027-28 sold out; an unsupported 'lower cost' claim removed) and Anchorage (Porto, not Lisbon; the co-founder claim sourced as general knowledge).
